old_caption: The video captures a serene landscape of rolling hills covered in dense evergreen forests. A thick layer of fog settles over the terrain, flowing and undulating across the hillsides. The fog begins at lower elevations and gradually rises, revealing more of the forested landscape above. The light changes subtly, suggesting early morning or late evening, casting a soft, diffused glow. The trees remain stationary, their dark silhouettes standing out against the lighter, moving mist. There are no visible animals or human characters, focusing entirely on the natural beauty and tranquility of the environment. The camera remains static, allowing viewers to absorb the peaceful interplay between the fog and the forest.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene and dynamic landscape of rolling hills covered in dense evergreen forests. As the sequence progresses, a thick layer of fog begins to settle over the terrain, creating a mesmerizing effect where the mist flows and undulates across the hillsides. The fog starts at the lower elevations and gradually rises, revealing more of the forested landscape above. The light changes subtly throughout the video, suggesting either early morning or late evening, casting a soft, diffused glow over the scene. The trees remain stationary, their dark silhouettes standing out against the lighter, moving mist. There are no visible animals or human characters in the video, focusing entirely on the natural beauty and tranquility of the environment. The camera remains static, allowing viewers to fully absorb the peaceful and ever-changing interplay between the fog and the forest.
caption: The video captures a fixed view of forested mountain ridges beneath a pale pink sky, where a broad river of white fog pours diagonally from the upper-left slope across the dark conifer silhouettes. The terrain, ridgelines, and foreground trees hold steady positions throughout, so all motion belongs to the drifting cloud. The thick fog band persists across the entire excerpt while its surface ripples and its edges continuously reform, flowing rather than translating as a rigid mass. Thin wisps swirl around the mid-foreground tree cluster on the left, alternately thickening into visible streaks and thinning out as the fog passes. In the lower valley and along the right-hand slope, the mist thickens and thins in patches, with wisps rising among the trees. A distant flat cloud sea and the smooth sheet draping the upper ridge remain largely steady, shifting only in subtle texture. The scene thus presents an ongoing, slow-flowing fog event rather than a completed action.

draft_caption: The video captures a fixed view of forested mountain ridges beneath a pale pink sky, where a broad river of white fog pours diagonally from the upper-left slope across the dark conifer silhouettes. The terrain, ridgelines, and foreground trees hold steady positions throughout, so all motion belongs to the drifting cloud. The thick fog band persists across the entire excerpt while its surface ripples and its edges continuously reform, flowing rather than translating as a rigid mass. Thin wisps swirl around the mid-foreground tree cluster on the left, alternately thickening into visible streaks and thinning out as the fog passes. In the lower valley and climbing the right-hand slope, the mist gradually deepens and spreads, with rising wisps appearing among the trees. A distant flat cloud sea and the smooth sheet draping the upper ridge remain largely steady, shifting only in subtle texture. The scene thus presents an ongoing, slow-flowing fog event rather than a completed action.
